tasks.title: Create the tracker and a Drive folder for scans
tasks.details: Name files clearly, e.g. Transcript_Y1_AR.pdf, Transcript_Y1_EN.pdf, Passport.pdf. Scan in colour, front and back.

tasks.title: Check IELTS computer-delivered dates in Algiers (target ~12 Dec)
tasks.details: Pick a date around 14–21 Nov 2026. Results arrive in 3–5 days.

tasks.title: Request documents from ENSIA scolarité (email, scheduled 10:00)
tasks.details: 1) Attestation describing the 5-year structure (prep years taught inside ENSIA, 30 credits/semester, 240 by end of year 4). 2) Attestation de classement. 3) Official course descriptions years 1–4, stamped. 4) French or English versions of the relevés (years 1–3) and attestation de scolarité 2026/27 you already have in Arabic. Ask for the procedure and how long it takes.

tasks.title: Ask ENSIA about remote final-year project
tasks.details: Wait until PoliTo answers. Then ask the head of studies: can year 5 (100% PFE) be done remotely from Italy? Who supervises? When is the defence? Any rule about being enrolled abroad at the same time?

tasks.title: Send eligibility emails to 5 universities
tasks.details: PoliTo (ticketing system), Polimi, Bologna, Padova, Sapienza. Use templates/eligibility_email.md.

tasks.title: IELTS diagnostic test (full, timed)
tasks.details: Cambridge IELTS Academic book, one full test. Note your weakest skill.

tasks.title: Bank: open your own account + international Visa card
tasks.details: Ask: documents needed, how long the card takes, that online payments abroad are enabled, and the foreign-currency (devise) balance. You need it for the PoliTo fee (~20 Dec). Also check your passport expires after 2029.

tasks.title: Visit 2–3 approved driving schools
tasks.details: Compare: package price (~30–35k DZD), schedule fit with classes, car availability, price of extra hours, how fast they get exam slots. Check the school is on the official approved list.

tasks.title: Shortlist programmes
tasks.details: Done for you (21 Oct): read the Universities cards. 2027 = PoliTo; Padova only if ENSIA can certify a completed cycle; Polimi, Sapienza, Bologna, Pisa and Trento need a finished degree by mid/late 2027. Tick this once you have read them.

tasks.title: Talk to Mom: visa funds + your own bank card
tasks.details: Two things. 1) Visa funds: €10,179.85 per year shown in a bank account, built up over time (not a last-minute deposit); a sponsor declaration from her is allowed. Ask whether it is possible and from which account. 2) She wants you to use your own card: agree on the bank visit (planned 8 Nov) and whether her card can pay the first fee if yours is not ready by mid-December.

tasks.title: Ask for the ENSIA documents (person the scolarité referred you to)
tasks.details: 18 Oct: the scolarité sent you to someone else, who was not in his office. Go back Monday. Bring a printed copy of the 13 Oct email. Ask for: 1) attestation of the 5-year structure (years 1–2 taught at ENSIA, 30 credits/semester, 240 by end of year 4); 2) attestation de classement; 3) official course descriptions years 1–4, stamped; 4) French or English versions of the relevés (years 1–3) and attestation de scolarité 2026/27. Also ask (decides Polimi): « Est-ce que l'ENSIA délivre un diplôme ou une attestation officielle à la fin de la 3e ou de la 4e année ? » Opening line: « Je vous ai envoyé un e-mail le 13 octobre pour une demande de documents, je voulais savoir si vous l'aviez reçu. » If she asks why: « C'est pour un dossier de candidature à un master. » If she asks where: « Je me renseigne sur plusieurs masters, y compris à l'étranger. Rien n'est encore décidé. » Both are true; keep it short and calm, no need to say more. Before leaving, ask when to come back or whether there's a form, and write the answer in this task's notes.

tasks.title: Book and pay IELTS Academic (computer-delivered)
tasks.details: Book the computer-delivered test closest to 12 Dec 2026 (results in 3–5 days, in time for PoliTo). ~37,000 DZD. Then update the IELTS deadline date in the app.

tasks.title: Register at the chosen driving school
tasks.details: Bring: birth certificate S12, residence certificate, ID copy, 4 biometric photos, fiscal stamp.

tasks.title: Medical certificate from a wilaya-approved doctor
tasks.details: Any doctor on the wilaya's approved list (médecin agréé). The driving school gives you the list, so do this right after registering. A normal GP certificate is not accepted.

tasks.title: Ask 2 professors for recommendation letters
tasks.details: Use the 'Recommendation request' template. Ask 2 professors who know your work; ask for the letter by 15 Dec.

tasks.title: Draft CV (Europass format)
tasks.details: Send Claude your current CV (the PDF you attached to the eligibility emails) for a first Europass draft, then fix it.

tasks.title: Clean up GitHub: top 3 projects with READMEs
tasks.details: Pin your 3 best projects. Give each repo a one-line description and topics, a README (what it does, how to run it, a screenshot), add a profile README, and make private anything unfinished you do not want reviewed.

tasks.title: Get quotes from 2–3 sworn translators (Arabic → English)
tasks.details: Ask price per page, turnaround, and whether they're also on the Italian Embassy's list of trusted translators (needed later for Italian translations for visa/DSU).

tasks.title: Follow up with scolarité on documents
PoliTo: follow up if no reply to the 13 Oct email
tasks.details: PoliTo is now the only 2027 option, so its answer matters most. If nothing by today, reply to your own email: 'Kind reminder of my question below. Thank you.'

tasks.title: Start code (theory) lessons
tasks.details: 25h of theory, usually 2–4 weeks. Exam is oral, ~10 min.

tasks.title: Motivation letter skeleton
tasks.details: Why AI, why Italy, why this programme, best 2 projects, career goal. One page.

tasks.title: Draft course-description document (years 1–4)
tasks.details: 3–5 lines of content per course, in English. Bologna wants 4–5 pages for main exams; PoliTo wants official syllabus.

tasks.title: Submit course descriptions to ENSIA for stamp/signature
Send Arabic documents to translator (→ English)
tasks.details: Only for documents ENSIA cannot issue in French or English.

tasks.title: Send CV + reminder to recommenders
Full IELTS mock on computer
Light review, prepare test-day logistics
tasks.details: ID, route, arrival time.

tasks.title: IELTS test day
Check IELTS results; book retake if below 6.5
tasks.details: Retake by early January at the latest.

tasks.title: Code exam
tasks.details: Exact date set by the wilaya commission via your school. Retake possible after ~15 days.

tasks.title: Tailor motivation letter for PoliTo (and Padova if applying)
Start driving lessons (2–3 per week)
tasks.details: Complete beginner: plan for the 30h package plus ~10–20 extra hours.

tasks.title: Collect English translations; scan everything
Check whether PoliTo and Pisa 2027/28 calls are published
tasks.details: PoliTo: dates, documents, and whether the English certificate is needed at application or can come later. Pisa: applymscenglish.unipi.it.

tasks.title: Assemble PoliTo application package
tasks.details: Passport, CV, transcripts + translations, provisional-graduation/structure letter, syllabus, IELTS, optional: rec letters, motivation letter.

tasks.title: Submit PoliTo 1st call application
tasks.details: Only submit when complete – incomplete applications are rejected for the whole year. €50 fee.

tasks.title: Créneau / manoeuvres exam
Padova Call 2 application (only if ENSIA cycle certificate)
All main applications done before exams
Exam period – admin only, 1 driving lesson/week max
Circulation (road) exam
tasks.details: Aim before Ramadan (~early Feb 2027). Retake possible after ~1 month.

tasks.title: Check MAECI call is open; confirm Algeria is eligible
tasks.details: studyinitaly.esteri.it

tasks.title: Backup applications in 2nd calls
Submit MAECI scholarship application
tasks.details: Deadline was 26 March last year – submit early.

tasks.title: Collect biometric licence
tasks.details: Production can take 4–8 weeks.

tasks.title: Request 2027 family income/property documents for DSU
tasks.details: Must be issued in 2027. Check the exact list on the DSU office site for your target region.

tasks.title: Translate DSU documents into Italian (embassy-trusted translator)
Legalize DSU documents: Algerian MFA, then Italian Embassy
Results: accept an offer
Universitaly pre-enrolment (right after admission)
Request CIMEA statement / Declaration of Value if required
Get official year-4 transcript and translate it
Book VFS appointment once pre-enrolment is validated
Prepare visa file
tasks.details: Validated Universitaly summary, proof of funds (€10,179.85), health insurance, accommodation proof, flight reservation (don't buy yet), translated/legalized documents.

tasks.title: Submit visa application at VFS
Submit DSU application (regional site)
Housing: DSU residence or room search
Buy flight after visa is issued
Arrive; apply for residence permit within 8 days
Decide on Padova (Call 2, by 1 Mar)
tasks.details: Padova does not pre-check eligibility (reply 19 Oct): you only find out by applying (€60). Their rule: cycle completed by 31 Jul 2027. Apply in Call 2 only if ENSIA gives an official certificate of a completed cycle (asked 22 Oct). Your average meets their Algeria minimum (11/20).

tasks.title: Email Pisa CS: can I apply before graduating?
tasks.details: 2 minutes: copy the 'Pisa eligibility' template (Templates tab), fill in your name, send to mcs_info@di.unipi.it.

tasks.title: Same visit: ask for a certificate of completed cycle
tasks.details: Padova accepts an official certificate of a completed study cycle instead of the diploma (deadline 31 July 2027). Ask: « Est-ce que l’ENSIA peut délivrer une attestation officielle de fin de cycle (cycle préparatoire ou 4 années / 240 crédits validés) ? » Also: pick up or follow up on the documents requested on 13–15 Oct, and ask about the intermediate diploma if not answered yet.
